title: Page
description: The words a built page carries that are not drawn from the corpus: a hero paragraph, the heading and sentence above a section. One document per page, keyed by the route it belongs to. Every slot is optional, and a slot nobody has filled in renders the wording the page was built with, so a deployment holding no page documents at all looks exactly as it did before this type existed.

key.description: Which page this describes. A closed set rather than a free slug, because a page document only means anything where the built page reads it, and a document keyed to a route nobody renders is a silent no-op that looks like a broken edit.

heroLede.description: The paragraph under the site's name, which says what the game is before it says what the site does. Rendered as text, never as markup.

booksHeading.description: The heading above the shelf of rulebooks.

booksLede.description: The sentence under that heading. Left empty it counts the books itself, which is the wording that cannot go stale; filling it in means you own the sentence, including any number in it.

resourcesHeading.description: The heading above the character sheets and other files the site hosts.

touchHeading.description: The heading above the community's links.
